searchSummary: The first slate planned 12 independent C behavior candidates before JavaScript comparison. Expanded screening covered command, naming, getpos, discovery, WhatIs, and special Lua branches. The final 29 cases have independent C replays: 13 distinct first-mismatch behaviors, 14 matching controls, and 2 valid target misses that match JavaScript. Sort-option and getpos name/mimic variants were collapsed into shared first-mismatch families. Five named doextcmd rows share a missing dispatcher switch but reach separate handlers and state contracts. Nine role-specific program probes reached the same generic place_lregion/LR_BRANCH refusal family; Arc-loca, Hea-loca, and Pri-fila matched. The Juiblex cursor-only route remains unresolved.
decision: Submit the 29-case v48 preparation packet with 13 source-distinct mismatches, 14 matching controls, and 2 matching target misses. The batch remains unadmitted and unscored.
